rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a feast day or ordinary holiday, rather than a named arts event.

example.english: Lunar New Year is one of the most important festival days for people in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 農曆新年係香港人最重視嘅節日之一。
example.jyutping: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 zeoi3 zung6 si6 ge3 zit3 jat6 zi1 jat1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a music festival.

example.english: We go to the music festival every year.
example.traditional: 我哋年年都去睇音樂節。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 nin4 nin4 dou1 heoi3 tai2 jam1 ngok6 zit3

rows.note: Use this for an arts festival or a festival promoting the arts more generally.

example.english: There are lots of local theatre performances at this arts festival.
example.traditional: 今個藝術節有好多本地戲劇表演。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 ngai6 seot6 zit3 jau5 hou2 do1 bun2 dei6 hei3 kek6 biu2 jin2
